title: Italian Tunnel and Cellar
preview: Enter a cooler, quieter part of Mylotopi. The tunnel and cellar connect stone, wine and the more hidden history of the 1940s.
details: As you step underground, notice the temperature, the curve of the walls and the way sound changes inside the stone passage.
Today, the cellar presents wine and atmosphere as part of the Mylotopi experience. The cool stone setting also reminds visitors that the same space once belonged to a different moment in history.
During the 1940s, the tunnel was connected with Italian soldiers. It offered a protected route and shelter, shaped by the needs and fears of wartime.

At the end of the passage, the route returns toward the restaurant area. The contrast is striking: a space once tied to protection and defense now leads visitors back to hospitality, food and the view over Kefalos.
When you leave the tunnel, continue toward the traditional house and bakery to return to the domestic life of the old village.
